retrievalProfile.description: A gritty, documentary-style instant photo aesthetic featuring a central vehicle on a suburban street with raw marker-style lettering on a wide bottom border.
triggerTerms: hand-written marker text on photo border

recipe.visualDefinition: A square instant-film composition featuring a dark minivan parked on a cracked asphalt street, framed by a distressed white border with raw, black marker handwriting and a standard content advisory badge.
coreVisualRelationships: Dark silhouette of a vehicle against a bright, desaturated suburban background
Wide bottom border acting as a canvas for expressive hand-lettering
Cracked asphalt texture mirroring the distressed edges of the photo frame
High-contrast content advisory badge balancing the organic handwriting
coreInvariants: White instant-film border with visible wear and tear

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A dark minivan occupies the center-middle ground, spanning approximately 70% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark mass of the vehicle provides a heavy anchor against the lighter sky and pavement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the dark vehicle, moves down to the expressive handwriting, and settles on the content advisory badge in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the wide white border and the expansive cracked pavement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated teal and blue in the sky and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the vehicle and marker ink.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted earth tones in the suburban houses.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the dark subject and the bright, weathered frame.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Informal, all-caps handwriting with varying baseline and stroke width.
letterConstructionRules: Overlapping strokes in rounded characters like 'O' and 'D'
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'A' and 'M' feature sharp, jagged peaks

composition.relationshipToImage: placed on the border below the image

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Organic handwriting paired with a rigid, geometric sans-serif for the advisory badge.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, street-level energy of the original lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a desaturated, film-grain photograph of a dark vehicle on a suburban street, framed within a distressed white instant-film border with scratches.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply black, hand-drawn marker lettering in the bottom center of the white border and a black-and-white content advisory badge in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the text rendered as raw handwriting?
Is the photo frame distressed with scratches?
Is the color palette desaturated and film-like?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the vehicle
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the marker text looks manually applied
Verify the border width is asymmetrical (wider at bottom)
Confirm the content advisory badge is legible
recipe.reuseFormula: Instant Film Frame + Suburban Street Photography + Raw Marker Lettering = Documentary Hip-Hop Aesthetic
